description: Send a request to the exact business from business_info. Pass the customer’s name and their message; ask only for missing details, and send only when the customer asks you to. No email, phone or account is required. This creates a conversation, not a confirmed booking, order, payment or inventory hold. Keep reply_token private: use inquiry_status to read the business’s reply and follow_up_business to continue. Do not send a second initial request when you already have a conversation. To contact another business as a business owner, use ask_business instead.
name: contact_business
title: Send a business a question or request
